changeSet.sql: create table local_demo_users ( tenant_id uuid not null, actor_id uuid not null, display_name varchar(120) not null, role_name varchar(64) not null, updated_at timestamptz not null default now(), updated_by uuid not null, primary key (tenant_id, actor_id), constraint ck_local_demo_user_role check (role_name in ('DOCUMENT_PROCESSOR','REPORT_VIEWER')) );
